mattdpearce.substack.com/p/c…
literally only the good surveillance AI is the one on my phone that tells me what the bird is

I am once again here to preach the good word that Thomas Pynchon is a gorgeously readable writer and also probably the greatest american prose stylist of at least the last 50 years and people who tell you his books are calculus tests for boys don’t love you and Vineland is a great place to start

This is such good reporting from Mia. Clipping is a hallmark of what I'm starting to think of as the anti-social web: the sheer volume crowds out content from people you know (fulfilling demand from the platforms) and the clips themselves are more a product of The Algorithm than the clipped text.
RIP media legend Ted Turner. Also a big-time conservationist: www.latimes.com/obituaries/s... via @mattdpearce.com
Unfortunately an unachieved bargaining demand to get more huge pictures of birds into the paper by union talent
Matt Pearce still having clout at the LA Times means the Brett Banditelli union bird photography spread dream is still alive??? 😭 😭
Welcome to bluesky, the hot new social media app where everyone knows who Ted Turner is.

Ted Turner, the former owner of WCW would be a better headline.  

Thanks for running WCW at a loss most of the years - I was happily entertained.

"Turner was one of the first adopters of cable and satellite broadcasting technology, and for many rural Americans living beyond the tower signals of major cities, Turner was the first person to bring them interesting TV."

I was one of the 8 people not in an airport who watched Headline News

Would we even have this show without Ted Turner? Just by launching TCM he has done more to keep film history alive than almost anyone else…

…and he was the best pro-wrestling rival that bastard Vince McMahon ever had. 

RIP Ted.

A surprise LA Times byline from me today: Ted Turner has died, and I had written his obituary before leaving the newsroom.

www.latimes.com/obituaries/s...
i aint reading all that. im happy for u though. or sorry that happened
The old LAT lobby was a treasure…

it was a cascade of failures reaching back to bankruptcy and various spinoffs, the new landlord was basically trying to shake down PSS, etc. But when the move to El Segundo happened, the guild created a heat map of where the journalists lived to show more of us would be spending the day on freeways

We looked into Polymarket's presence in Panama, obtained its government paperwork and visited its headquarters in Panama City. 

There was no sign of Polymarket. Nobody had heard of Polymarket there. 

www.npr.org/2026/05/05/n...
Yeah, mood. "Logging on anywhere these days is like punching in for another unpaid shift at the nudge factory."
Matt Pearce was a leader in the fight to unionize the LA Times!

I wrote a brief personal history of millennial identity formation from college: the icky-social-psych to Hannah Arendt “don’t be evil, idiot” pipeline.

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/obeying-qu...
The suckers are the whole business. That’s it. The whole ballgame. If there are no suckers there’s nothing for sharks to eat.
